kind: Complete registered background reconstruction on one prepared development window

registration.appearance: original parent residual-off bytes; no free appearance
registration.registration: masked ORB frame-to-frame0, ratio0.75 RANSAC1px, identity fallback
registration.maps: one little-endian float32 3x3 per emitted frame; charged NPY bytes
registration.plate: frame0 canvas, masked temporal median, uncovered pixels fall back to original frame0
registration.quality: whole RGB and uint8 BT601 Y pooled PSNR; parent-mask FG/BG diagnostics only
registration.exposure: offline complete-window encoder access; one development window
registration.selection: eight fixed arms retained; no quality-driven plate/map selection
registration.resets: new complete coded plate every12/24 prepared frames; all repetitions and segment manifest charged
registration.compute: CPU only; representative full48 reset12 and identity smoke before eight-arm full48; root phase3 gate
registration.native_plate_recipe: SVT-AV1 preset10 CQP rc0 aq-mode0 lp4; FFmpeg yuv420p conversion
registration.anchor_policy: join root-owned complete common anchor report later, never re-encode anchors here
